title: Cooking
learning_outcomes: Explain food hygiene and allergens in the context of cooking.
Compare and distinguish cooking methods in the context of cooking.
Apply timing and ingredients in the context of cooking.
Evaluate and justify decisions about waste reduction in the context of cooking.

lessons.title: Food hygiene and allergens
lessons.outcome: Explain food hygiene and allergens in the context of cooking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving food hygiene and allergens; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to safe meal plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain food hygiene and allergens from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of food hygiene and allergens; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cooking methods
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish cooking methods in the context of cooking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cooking methods; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to safe meal plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cooking methods from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cooking methods; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Timing and ingredients
lessons.outcome: Apply timing and ingredients in the context of cooking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving timing and ingredients; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to safe meal plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain timing and ingredients from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of timing and ingredients; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Waste reduction
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about waste reduction in the context of cooking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving waste reduction; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to safe meal plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain waste reduction from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of waste reduction; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of food hygiene and allergens; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cooking methods; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of timing and ingredients; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of waste reduction; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
